label: At the selected world every cause of the…, from Whatever causes the spacetime whole to… and 1 more
meaning: Owner's step (2), #1109: suppose c causes the spacetime whole and is a part of it. By the whole-to-part bridge c causes c, which no efficient cause does (ST I q.2 a.3, at the selected world's causation with a trivial respect). So every cause of the whole lies outside spacetime. No existence of a cause is assumed.
